This includes evaluating the proposed experimental procedures, anesthesia and analgesia protocols, and humane endpoints (criteria for removing an animal from the study if it experiences unacceptable levels of distress). The IRB will scrutinize the justification for any procedures that may cause discomfort.

This includes assessing the adequacy of the facilities, the veterinary care plan, and the qualifications of personnel involved in animal care.
